settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, theme, scale, API keys
settings.tmdb_key_hint: Leave empty to use the built-in app key.
settings.tmdb_key_placeholder: Paste your key or leave empty
settings.tmdb_key_tooltip: Why your own key? First, your own request limit — 40 requests per second just for you. Second, the built-in key may run out if many users. Your own key is free, takes 1 minute to get.
settings.tmdb_key_get_link: Get a free key at themoviedb.org →
settings.refresh_metadata_hint: Re-fetches posters, descriptions, cast and collections for all movies and TV shows. May take a few minutes.
settings.refresh_metadata_confirm: Refresh metadata for all movies and TV shows? This may take a few minutes.
settings.refresh_language_hint: Re-fetches titles and descriptions in the current language for all movies and TV shows.
settings.refresh_language_confirm: Refresh titles and descriptions in the current language? This may take a few minutes.
settings.reset_description: Completely delete all movies, TV shows, anime, achievements and progress. Profile returns to level 1, 0 XP.
settings.reset_modal_title: Are you sure you want to delete everything?
settings.reset_modal_description: This action cannot be undone. All watched movies, TV shows, anime, achievements, XP and level will be permanently deleted.
settings.export_hint: Save the entire library, achievements, diary and collections to a single JSON file.
settings.import_hint: Load a previously saved JSON. Current data will be replaced.
settings.import_confirm: Import will replace the entire current library and progress. Continue?
settings.sync_hint: Press the button on any device in the same Wi-Fi network — devices will find each other and exchange changes. First time you'll need to confirm the connection.
settings.sync_awaiting: New devices found — confirm the connection
settings.sync_error_firewall: Could not connect. Windows Firewall is likely blocking sync. On first launch, click "Allow access" when Windows asks. If that doesn't help, add a rule for port 47820 in firewall settings.
settings.sync_forget_confirm: Forget this device? You'll have to confirm the connection again.
settings.sync_pair_description: New devices found in this Wi-Fi network. Confirm the connection to sync your library.
